en.title: Aviation briefs: Cathay Pacific Exercises Rights for 11 More Airbus A330-900s, Firm Total Reaches 41; Archer Aviation and Formula 1 sign partnership to explore air taxi flights at races
en.summary: 2 independent updates: Cathay Pacific Exercises Rights for 11 More Airbus A330-900s, Firm Total Reaches 41; Archer Aviation and Formula 1 sign partnership to explore air taxi flights at races.
body:
1. Cathay Pacific Exercises Rights for 11 More Airbus A330-900s, Firm Total Reaches 41
Cathay Pacific exercises rights for 11 Airbus A330-900s, taking firm orders to 41.

2. Archer Aviation and Formula 1 sign partnership to explore air taxi flights at races
Archer Aviation and Formula 1 signed a partnership to explore air taxi flights at races.

facts.claim: Cathay Pacific exercised purchase rights for 11 additional Airbus A330-900 aircraft, bringing its firm orders for the type to 41.
facts.sourceQuote: Cathay Pacific has exercised purchase rights for 11 additional Airbus A330-900 aircraft, bringing its firm orders for the type to 41

facts.claim: The Cathay Group placed a firm order for 14 additional Airbus aircraft, comprising 11 A330-900s and three A321neos.
facts.sourceQuote: Hong Kong’s Cathay Group has placed a firm order for 14 additional Airbus aircraft, comprising 11 A330-900s and three A321neos

facts.claim: Cathay expects the eleven new aircraft to be delivered between 2031 and 2035.
facts.sourceQuote: Cathay expects the eleven new aircraft to be delivered between 2031 and 2035.

facts.claim: The purchase rights date back to Cathay’s 2024 purchase agreement with Airbus, under which the airline ordered 30 A330-900s and secured the right to acquire 30 more.
facts.sourceQuote: The rights date back to Cathay’s 2024 purchase agreement with Airbus, under which the airline ordered 30 A330-900s and secured the right to acquire 30 more.

facts.claim: The new A330-900s are to progressively replace Cathay Pacific’s existing mid-size widebody aircraft, primarily serving regional routes in Asia with flexibility to operate longer-haul services in the future.
facts.sourceQuote: The new A330-900s will progressively replace Cathay Pacific’s existing mid-size widebody aircraft, primarily serving regional routes in Asia, with the flexibility to operate longer-haul services in the future.

facts.claim: Archer Aviation and Formula 1 signed a multi-year partnership that could see air taxi flights at Grand Prix circuits during the motor racing season.
facts.sourceQuote: Archer Aviation and Formula 1 have signed a multi-year partnership that could see air taxi flights at Grand Prix circuits during the motor racing season.

facts.claim: The parties will explore opportunities to introduce electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft services at select events.
facts.sourceQuote: the two parties will explore opportunities to introduce electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft services at select events in the calendar year.

facts.claim: Archer's vision includes flying VIPs, stakeholders and fans to and from race circuits using the eVTOL aircraft Midnight.
facts.sourceQuote: Archer’s vision for Formula 1 air taxi services includes flying VIPs, stakeholders and fans to and from race circuits using the developer’s eVTOL aircraft ‘Midnight’.

facts.claim: According to Archer, the partnership will look at providing dedicated air taxi drop-off and pick-up locations at circuits.
facts.sourceQuote: According to Archer, the partnership will look at providing dedicated air taxi drop-off and pick-up locations at circuits

facts.claim: The agreement includes Archer's presence as an official supporter at events aligned with markets where the company plans to operate, including the US, Middle East, Asia and Europe.
facts.sourceQuote: agreement also includes Archer’s presence as an official supporter at events which align with key commercial markets that the company plans to operate in such as the US, Middle East, Asia and Europe
